DILG DACONO Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City MAR 12 2025 vmwdilq.qov.ph OPINION NO. GILBERT M. GUTIERREZ Lusod, Lobos, Romblon, Philippines 5500 gilbertmgutz@gmail.com Dear Mr. Gutierrez: This has reference to the letter dated 6 January 2025 of Mn Gilbert M. Gutierrez regarding the request for clarification on the decentralization of the responsibilities of DPWH to local government units (LGUs) regarding road repairs, rehabilitation projects in the Municipality of Romblon, Romblon. At the outset, we would like to thank your good office for this clarification. While we afirm that the matter brought before us is in keeping with this Departments mandate over the exercise of general supervision over LGUs, we find that the matter falls beyond this Office's jurisdiction. We refer the matter to Memorandum Order No. 2010-021 dated 17 September 2010 which provides that the Department shall not act on queries of the following kinds, to wit (1) Those containing facts that are justiciable in nature. Justiciable issues are those that require adjudication by the courts of law as to who between the opposing parties have the better right over a given controversy; (2) Those presumptively valid acts, e.g., enacted ordinances, consummated acts that already enjoy the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer concemed, and similar instances; (3) Those that are litis pendencia or pending litigation, except when the court itself requests for the opinion. In the event that an opinion has been rendered by the Department and its field officers without knowledge or information that a case involving the issues raised in the query is pending in court, such opinion shall automatically be deemed ineffective; and (4) Those that are cognizable by other agencies of the government. [emphasis supplied] Notwithstanding, the Department has already endorsed this inquiry to the Department of Public Works & Highways (DPWH) for their appropriate action particularly the I Supplement to Memorandum Order No. 2010-01 dated 4 March 2010.
